item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description:
2026-08-01 - Version 1.3.1, pandoc 3.10.1 and a pinned version (PR #134)

  • The bundled pandoc is now 3.10.1, picking up upstream’s latest round of small fixes (#133). The fetch script pins the exact version it installs instead of grabbing whatever is newest, so the repo records what every build bundles and a pandoc update becomes a deliberate one-line change. The script still verifies the maintainer’s Developer ID signature and notarization, and now also confirms the installed binary matches the pinned version. Ships as 1.3.1 (build 9).

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
2026-08-01 - Version 1.3.0, the app updates itself (PR #127)

  • Check for Updates lives in the tray menu, and the app checks quietly once a week on its own (#62). When a new version exists, a window shows what changed and one click installs it, verified against the app’s signing key before a byte of it runs. Two switches in General tune the behavior: the weekly check itself, and fully automatic installs for people who never want to think about versions. No internet? Nothing appears; a background check that fails just waits for next week. Downloads and the update feed live in the public releases repo, so the code can stay private while updates flow. This is 1.3.0 (build 8), the first build that can update itself: anyone on 1.2.1 grabs the new DMG once, and never again.
